changelog:
keyapi-facebook 1.0.0

- Initial release of the keyapi-facebook skill.
- Enables live exploration and analysis of public Facebook data (profiles, pages, posts, photos, Reels, groups, events) using the KeyAPI REST API.
- Provides a detailed workflow for mapping user requests to API scenarios and endpoints, strictly following official KeyAPI documentation.
- Includes robust authentication onboarding, with command-line setup scripts and automatic status detection.
- Supports helper scripts for API calls, docs search, and local credential management to streamline execution.
- Emphasizes scenario-based routing, safe credential handling, and never falling back to non-API data sources.
summary: Explore and analyze public Facebook data through the KeyAPI REST API using live official docs. Use for profile and page details, profile posts, photos, Reels, group details, group posts, future group events, and profile/group identifier resolution.
